paragraphs.text: Darux is a Rakdos Spiker and Ringleader from Ravnica - a pierced titan towering over the members of his ring.

Darux was originally part of the goblin Stroko 's ring, but left after they had a falling out. He recruited Vildika from Massacre Girl 's ring after those two had a similar falling out, and he ended up falling for her. Together, they hosted the Slaughter Games , a massive parade filling the streets with a dreadful cacophony of dragging chains, mad cackling, and the screams of agony by those who were swept up in their gruesome marching carnival. Amidst the bloody parade, the carnival included bladed stilt walkers, a mobile aerial chain act, body-pierced high-flying trapeze artists, and other ghastly sights.
